_doc: Declared parity between game and editor for each governed render pass. Source of truth for scripts/check-editor-pass-contract-parity.py. The checker FAILs on undeclared drift (a governed RenderPassId present in RenderPassContract.h but absent here) and on internal inconsistency (unknown classification, missing rationale, classification/status contradiction).
_editor_render_path: editor/EditorGameOS.cpp pp_editor->beginScene() (MRT incl. COLOR_ATTACHMENT2 object-id) -> Environment.UpdateRenderers() (editor/Editor.cpp -> editor->render(), the SAME shared world renderer the game runs) -> pp_editor->endScene() (PostProcess composite).

passes.rationale: Editor runs the identical GpuStaticPropBatcher via Environment.UpdateRenderers()->editor->render(). Same PassId, same PipelineDesc, same scene-FBO attachment contract (beginScene MRT). No editor override.
Editor renders terrain through the same shared world renderer. Identical PassId/pipeline/attachments. Editor map-edit mutates terrain data, not the pass contract.
Editor places/previews mechs through the same GpuMechBatcher pass. Same contract.
Shadow pass is part of the shared renderer/post-process driven by the same getGosPostProcess() instance (pp_editor) the editor begins/ends. Same depth attachment contract.
Particle/VFX batcher runs inside the shared world renderer. Same PassId/pipeline. Editor may quiesce gameplay-spawned effects but the pass contract is identical when active.
Water fast path renders through the same shared terrain/water draw. Same attachment + depth-fudge contract.

The editor frame is bracketed by the SAME gosPostProcess instance: pp_editor->beginScene()/endScene() in editor/EditorGameOS.cpp mirror gameosmain.cpp. The only editor delta is the composite TARGET viewport (render-to-texture bottom-left region vs full FBO0) — a host-level blit destination, NOT a change to the PostProcess PassId, pipeline, or attachment formats. Declared as shared (not override) because the governed contract — pipeline + attachment formats incl. COLOR_ATTACHMENT2 object-id MRT — is byte-identical; only the final glViewport differs.
Vegetation cards render via the shared renderer. Same contract.
Terrain decals render through the shared terrain draw. Same coplanar-decal depth contract.
Terrain overlay (cement/road/transition) renders through the shared terrain draw. Same contract.

The governed UI pass (GameOS 2D draw) is shared. Note: the editor ADDS its own ImGui/dockspace + gizmo UI on top, but that is the editor-only chrome enumerated below, not a mutation of the governed UI PassId.

Translation/rotation manipulator gizmos drawn over the scene for object placement. Legitimately not a game pass — no gameplay frame renders manipulators. Not governed; no game PassId to drift against.
Selection highlight / bounding outlines for the currently-selected object(s). Editor authoring affordance only.
Paint/place brush footprint preview (terrain texture brush, building stamp). Authoring-time visualization; no game equivalent.

The object-id MRT (COLOR_ATTACHMENT2) IS written by the shared PostProcess/scene FBO in BOTH game and editor; what is editor-only is the READBACK + pick visualization (Ctrl+Shift+LMB lookupAtPixel). The attachment-write contract is covered by the shared PostProcess row; only the readback/debug-viz consumer is editor-only and unguverned.
